name: CoLlAGe Radiomics
shortDescription: Voxel-wise radiomics from co-occurrences of local gradient orientations.
principalDevelopers: BrIC Laboratory; Rob Toth and Nathan Hillyer (Toth Technology); RadxTools contributors
longDescription: Co-occurrence of Local Anisotropic Gradient Orientations (CoLlAGe) describes local disorder in image gradients. This open-source Python implementation produces thirteen voxel-wise Haralick statistics from 2D or 3D image regions. It includes a medical-image command-line interface, reproducible notebooks, Docker targets, and a 3D Slicer extension. The 0.4 series corrects numerical behavior from 0.3.x; experiments upgrading from that series should recompute cached features and record extraction parameters.

keyReferences.referenceText: Prasanna, Tiwari, and Madabhushi (2016). Co-occurrence of Local Anisotropic Gradient Orientations (CoLlAGe): A new radiomics descriptor. Scientific Reports 6:37241.
